 Deconstruct appoints cricketer Nitish Kumar Reddy as brand partner
 Deconstruct has partnered with Indian cricketer Nitish Kumar Reddy to expand its market among younger audiences. Reddy's association with the brand began after he was seen using its sunscreen in an Instagram story. The collaboration will lead to upcoming campaigns centered on Deconstruct's SPF 50 PA++++ gel sunscreen. Malini Adapureddy emphasized the growing interest in skincare among men.

 Highlights

 Reddy highlights the importance of sun protection for athletes.
 Nitish Reddy partners with Deconstruct to reach younger consumers Deconstruct has signed Indian cricketer Nitish Kumar Reddy as its brand partner to expand its reach among younger consumers .
The association developed organically after Reddy was spotted using Deconstruct’s gel sunscreen in an Instagram story posted by his sister, followed by a social media video featuring his pet dog discovering the product in his gym bag. To announce the partnership, the brand rolled out billboards in Hyderabad and Vizag featuring the headline 'In a situationship with Nitish Reddy', referencing a recent press-conference remark by the cricketer.
 Advt 
 As part of the collaboration, Reddy will front upcoming campaigns and digital content highlighting Deconstruct’s skincare portfolio, centred around its SPF 50 PA++++ gel sunscreen.
 Malini Adapureddy , founder and CEO, Deconstruct, said, “With men accounting for a significant portion of our consumer base, we are witnessing a growing interest in effective, uncomplicated skincare. Nitish brings a strong connection with younger audiences and represents a generation that increasingly recognises the importance of personal care.”
 Reddy added, “Sun protection is an essential part of an athlete’s routine and I'm glad to partner with a brand that is setting the right benchmark in this space.”
